units.title: Properties of 2D and 3D shapes and symmetry

lessons.title: Mark the position of points specified by coordinates in the first quadrant of a coordinate grid
Reflect polygons in a line of symmetry

misconceptions.text: Children do not start counting from the origin, or plot the y value before the x value
Children copy or translate a shape rather than flipping it over the line of symmetry; they also think a shape is symmetrical just because it splits in half
